title: OMI AI Tool-Assisted Analysis Candidate Review MVP
parent_title: PHASE8-IMPL-023 - OMI AI Tool-Assisted Analysis Candidate Review MVP
purpose: Build the real MVP OMI path where raw idea input is analyzed by an AI/tool-assisted analysis orchestrator and converted into structured, evidence-backed review candidates for owner review.

supersedes: docs/roadmap/decisions/PHASE8-IMPL-023-T001-omi-extraction-gap-audit-architecture-decision.md where it selected deterministic/rule-based extraction as the first MVP target
owner_override.historical_owner_gate_status: accepted by explicit owner decision but not full MVP completion

current_gap: Backend deterministic marker extraction exists for explicit owner-authored markers but is now fallback/safety baseline only.
The corrected MVP requires AI/tool-assisted OMI analysis using Ollama/local models, Story Check, BookNLP, spaCy, NCP, Subtxt, and dramatica-flow.

The orchestrator contract, adapter boundaries, deterministic fallback, and Ollama/model fixture-only structured extraction contract now exist; BookNLP/spaCy, Story Check, NCP/Subtxt/dramatica-flow, fusion/dedupe, fused persistence, and frontend analysis-results UI remain planned.
mvp_behavior: User enters or saves raw idea text in OMI.
OMI runs tool-assisted analysis through an orchestrator.
Adapters return candidate findings, diagnostics, evidence, provenance, source locators, and support labels.
A normalization layer converts all outputs to a common OMI candidate schema.
A fusion/dedupe layer groups equivalent findings and preserves conflicts or uncertainty.
The UI lists findings grouped by type, tool/provenance, and evidence.
The owner confirms, rejects, or revises findings.
required_candidate_fields: support/confidence as support only, not truth
acceptance_criteria: Given raw idea text, OMI can produce non-empty tool-assisted candidate findings where evidence exists.
Candidate list is visible in UI and grouped by type.
Each candidate has candidate type, label/name, extracted claim, evidence/source excerpt, source locator, provenance/tool source, support label, status, and owner decision state.
Diagnostics/questions are shown where appropriate without writing or suggesting story prose.
Empty or unsupported analysis fails closed with a clear explanation and does not create misleading empty shells.
UI clearly separates extracted candidates from approved Memory/Canon.
Tool/model output is never treated as canon or truth.
ui_ux_scope: Clear next action after candidate analysis.

architecture.orchestrator: OMI analysis orchestrator receives raw idea text and coordinates bounded analysis adapters.
architecture.adapters: Each adapter returns candidate findings, diagnostics, evidence, provenance, and support labels.
architecture.normalization: All adapter outputs are converted to the common OMI candidate schema.
architecture.fusion_dedupe: Equivalent findings are grouped while conflicts and uncertainty remain visible.
architecture.persistence: Fused evidence-backed candidates are stored as candidate/review material only.
architecture.ui: The UI lists what was found, grouped by type/tool/evidence, and asks the owner to confirm, reject, or revise.

tool_boundaries: Ollama/model: structured extraction only, schema-bound JSON, no prose, no rewriting.
Story Check: diagnostic-only observations, no prose suggestions.
BookNLP/spaCy: entities/events/relationships/mentions as evidence-backed candidate sources.
NCP: structural context candidate mapping, not truth export.
Subtxt: rubric/diagnostic interpretation, not automatic Dramatica truth.
dramatica-flow: analysis-pattern reference only; generation/revision/continuation disabled.
boundaries: candidate approval does not automatically mutate Memory/Canon
